questions.question: What is the role of sports analytics in modern sports management? / [CO4]
questions.solution_html: • What is the role of sports analytics in modern sports management? Answer: Sports analytics involves the collection and interpretation of data related to athletes’ performance, team efficiency, fan engagement, and financial operations. Performance Optimization: Helps coaches design training programs, track fatigue, and improve tactics. Injury Prevention: Identifies physical stress patterns to minimize injuries. Talent Scouting: Uses metrics to assess potential players. Strategic Decision-Making: Assists in game strategy and substitution decisions. Fan Engagement & Marketing: Data insights enhance ticket sales, sponsorship, and fan experience. Example: IPL franchises use data analytics for player selection and in-game decision-making.

questions.question: How did cricket evolve as a national passion in India? / [CO1]
questions.solution_html: • How did cricket evolve as a national passion in India? Answer: Introduced by the British during colonial rule. Indian teams formed in the early 1900s; 1932 marked India’s first Test match. Major turning points: 1983 World Cup victory ignited national pride. Liberalization in the 1990s brought TV coverage and sponsorships. IPL (2008 onwards) turned cricket into a mass entertainment industry. Cricket now transcends class and region—seen as a unifying national identity.

questions.question: Examine the challenges in implementing sports policies in India. / [CO3]
questions.solution_html: • Examine the challenges in implementing sports policies in India. Answer: Fragmented Governance: Overlapping roles between central and state authorities. Inadequate Funding: Limited allocation for non-cricket sports. Poor Infrastructure: Rural areas lack basic facilities. Corruption & Bureaucracy: Hinders timely execution. Lack of Accountability: Policies often fail due to poor monitoring. Example: National Sports Policy (2001) and Khelo India initiatives aim to fix these gaps. Suggestions: Strengthen governance, increase private participation, and ensure transparent fund use.
questions.source_exam: Third Semester MGU-UGP(Hons.) Regular Exam Oct 2025

questions.question: Analyze the challenges and opportunities for the ISL in establishing a sustainable and successful professional football league in India. / [CO6]
questions.solution_html: • Analyze the challenges and opportunities for the ISL in establishing a sustainable and successful professional football league in India. Answer: Challenges: Low grassroots participation. Limited fan following compared to cricket. Financial instability of smaller clubs.
